The '''Osseriton system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its sole [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Osseriton/Legends|Osseriton]].
